## Expert Opportunity - Data Scientist ($80/hr, up to $1,600/week)

![Ethos](https://cdn.getro.com/companies/80b3b2b5-1251-4731-b378-0d8d1bcb4f59-1762911521)

Ethos

People & HR, Data Science·Contractor

India

INR 80-80 / hour

Postedon Sep 21, 2026

[Apply now](https://in.linkedin.com/jobs/view/expert-opportunity-data-scientist-%2480-hr-up-to-%241-600-week-at-ethos-4455139416?utm_source=General+Catalyst+job+board&utm_medium=getro.com&gh_src=General+Catalyst+job+board)

**About This Opportunity** We're working with a leading foundational AI lab to find experienced data scientists who can help train their latest language model on professional document, spreadsheet, and slide deck tasks.

We're looking for data scientists with 4+ years building software, AI/ML systems, or data infrastructure in a professional engineering or data role to create, evaluate, and refine AI-generated documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks across core workflows: technical design documents and architecture decision records, data pipeline and ETL documentation, model evaluation and AI system readiness reports, API specification and integration guides, data quality and validation test plans, and developer onboarding guides and system architecture diagrams.

**Compensation:** $80/hour

**Commitment:** Flexible, 5-20 hours per week (or more if desired)

**Location:** Fully remote, work on your own schedule

**Start date:** ASAP

**Qualifications**

- 4+ years as a software engineer, data engineer, or AI/ML practitioner writing technical design documents, data pipeline documentation, or API specifications
- Direct experience evaluating model outputs or system readiness and documenting technical tradeoffs for engineering or cross-functional stakeholders
- Expert-level document, spreadsheet, and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail


**About Ethos** Ethos is a new expert network built by a McKinsey/SoftBank/DeepMind team and backed by world-leading investors like General Catalyst. We connect experts with investors and consultancies for paid expert calls, speaking engagements, and advisory opportunities.

**Key Requirements**

- 4+ years as a software engineer, data engineer, or AI/ML practitioner writing technical design documents, data pipeline documentation, or API specifications
- Direct experience evaluating model outputs or system readiness and documenting technical tradeoffs for engineering or cross-functional stakeholders
- Expert-level document, spreadsheet, and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail
